en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ali Bin Ibrahim Al Ja’fary, from Muhammad and Ahmad the two sons of Umar Bin Musa, from their father, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The staining (of the food) with the vinegar cuts the desire of the adultery’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ibrahim al-Ja‘fariy from Muhammad and Ahmad sons of ‘Umar ibn Musa from their father in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Using vinegar as sauce cuts down the desire of fornication.’”
